input.text:
tok 1.0 "Subscription"

pool org "Subscription service"
  lane customer "Customer"
    start signup "Customer signs up"
    task enter "Enter personal and payment information"
    task receive "Receive updates and notifications"
    xor cancel "Cancel subscription?"
    task request "Submit cancellation request"
  lane system "System"
    task generate "Generate account"
    task assign "Assign access"
    task bill "Trigger automated billing cycles"
  lane support "Support team"
    task process "Process cancellation request"
    task apply "Apply refunds or charges"
    task deactivate "Deactivate subscription"
    task settle "Settle final account balance"
    end done "Subscription closed"

flow signup -> enter -> generate -> assign -> bill -> receive -> cancel
flow cancel -> receive "no"
flow cancel -> request "yes"
flow request -> process -> apply -> deactivate -> settle -> done
